title: OOBB gears
summary: Parametric OOBB gears in big and little scales, including standard, flange, clam-shell, bearing and bevel variants.
parts: Choose the gear scale, tooth count, style and depth. The exported print layout may contain several components for a single variant.
assembly: Use the selected variant’s geometry and metadata to check the mating gear, shaft and bearing requirements. Existing component-specific fit and bevel examples remain available.
